note: Assistive technology, platform and research configuration. Versions are pins to be recorded per session, not claims that this Skill Tool can execute these environments. No screen reader, browser or device is installed or automated by the tool.

nvda.name: NVDA
nvda.environment: Windows 11 (pin OS build) + Firefox ESR or Chrome (pin version)

talkback.name: TalkBack
shortcuts: Swipe down then right: reading controls

orca.name: Orca
orca.environment: Linux (pin distribution and kernel) + Firefox (pin version)

chromevox.name: ChromeVox
chromevox.environment: ChromeOS (pin version) or Chrome extension (pin version)

combinations.focus: focus order, traps, skip link, target size

combinations.at: Voice control (Windows Voice Access / iOS Voice Control)
combinations.focus: label in name, visible label matching

platform_pins.web-desktop: Pin browser build, OS build, viewport size and device pixel ratio.
platform_pins.web-mobile: Pin browser build, OS build, device model and orientation.
platform_pins.android: Pin app version, Android version, device model and TalkBack version.
platform_pins.ios: Pin app version, iOS version, device model and VoiceOver version.
platform_pins.desktop: Pin application version and OS build.
platform_pins.kiosk: Pin kiosk shell version, display size, input devices and timeout settings.

research_instruments.recruitment: Recruit through disability organisations and community groups. Never recruit from the delivery team or from people who built the feature.
research_instruments.compensation: Compensate at or above the local market rate for the participant's time. Pay even if the session ends early; never make payment conditional on completing tasks.
research_instruments.consent_format: Offer the consent form in screen-reader-friendly HTML, large print and a plain-language summary, in the participant's preferred language.

screen-reader: Participant uses their own AT and settings
Provide the task list in advance in an accessible format
Do not ask the participant to explain their AT
keyboard-only: Confirm the session tool does not require a mouse
Share the task list with keyboard shortcuts
low-vision: Allow the participant to set their own zoom and colour settings
cognitive: Allow a support person if requested
mobile: Confirm the participant's device and OS
Provide a test build link that works over their data plan
deaf-hard-of-hearing: Provide live captions for the session
motor: Accept spoken answers in place of typed ones
voice-control: Confirm microphone access and quiet environment
switch-access: Confirm switch setup and scanning speed

compatibility_note: Coverage is a claim about which environments were tested, never about how assistive technology will behave everywhere. Record the pinned versions with every finding.
